'''Sulkhaz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] criminal and the leader of the [[Blood of Talath]] tribe that was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] the Rattataki broke free, but Sulkhaz was confronted and killed by a Republic citizen.
